## Purpose / Objet

Describe the change and agreed scope. Link only non-sensitive issue references.

## Target / Cible

- Target branch and milestone:
- Why this belongs on that branch (stable P0.1 versus P1-A development):
- Owner scope authorization, where required (no private transcript or audit attachment):

## Changes and limits / Modifications et limites

- Behavior changed:
- Data, dependency, source-collection or storage impact:
- FR/EN implications:
- Non-goals and known limitations:

## Local validation / Validation locale

List actual commands and sanitized results. State checks not run and why. Do not paste private paths or raw logs; historical milestone counts are not this PR's result.

## Recovery / Retour arrière

Describe safe recovery if relevant; preserve existing code and data. No automatic overwrite or destructive reset.

## Review checklist / Revue

- [ ] I am authorized to propose this work and have read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] The target branch is intentional; P1-A connectors are not silently added to stable main.
- [ ] Required local tests/build and relevant regressions ran; documentation links/commands were also checked where applicable. Any missing required check blocks acceptance.
- [ ] English/French behavior is equivalent, command blocks match, and official source values remain intact.
- [ ] No secrets, private computer paths, database/raw-source dumps, private audit material or unredacted evidence is included.
- [ ] No unauthorized external write, automatic collection/browser launch, public bind, paid service or Actions workflow is introduced.
- [ ] Any third-party material has identified provenance; this PR does not assert a new project license or rights grant.
- [ ] Owner review is requested. A structural merge, release or visibility change still requires explicit JLV GO.

Security vulnerabilities must use the private route in SECURITY.md, not this PR. This checklist requests review; it does not establish enforced GitHub protection or authorize a merge.
